steps: Corpus: a LOCAL neutral English corpus, one sentence per line (candidate: WikiText-103 train; licence and the exact file to be confirmed and registered). Nothing is downloaded by the pipeline.
Filter: keep lines with 5-40 words, no hit of the EMOTION_WORDS lexicon (build_p3k_stimuli.py), and no 6-gram shared with the task scenarios (stimuli_v0/p3k_pairs.csv); drop exact duplicates.
Sample n = 2000 lines with the registered seed (SEED['subsample'] in p3k_directions.py).
Hidden states: raw text, no chat template, last token, hidden_states[L] (same layer L as all directions).
Directions: mean-center the n x h matrix; the top k = 5 right singular vectors are the directions neu_pc_1..5 (sign: positive skew of the scores), subspace H_neu_pc = their span.

Use: non-human-label comparison directions (not in the affect set A by default). Report the explained variance; the top PCs of raw residual activations can be dominated by outlier dimensions, so the whitened metric of p3k_kill_tests.py applies to them as to every other direction.
